verdict.rationale: Docs show fully programmatic creation of FinancialAccount objects (money_manager configuration), platform onboarding, funding, and money movement via API (docs-2, docs-7, docs-16, docs-23), supporting the 'apply and activate via API' part of the story. However, there is no evidence in the pack explicitly confirming deposit insurance (FDIC pass-through) for these accounts, nor any documentation of sandbox/test-mode parity for the Treasury account-opening flow specifically. Missing for 10: explicit insured-deposit language, sandbox/test-mode documentation for Treasury account creation, independent confirmation of full API-only onboarding without manual review.
